description: Random init baseline; prints the public attributes of the task object.
Random init again; prints example format from a non-eval seed to learn padding and labels.
Word detectors (hand lexicon of SNLI artifact words) vote per class; hypothesis trigram coverage of premise sets thresholds.
Same weights as e03; adds a measurement-only confusion matrix on a separate seed.
Lower the coverage threshold for entailment from 0.8 to 0.65 to raise entailment recall.
Adds mutually exclusive concept groups: a hypothesis word whose group is in the premise but whose member is not votes contradiction.
Lower COV_LOW from 0.35 to 0.15: with explicit conflicts, low coverage now points to neutral rather than contradiction.
Two pooling heads measure sentence padding; a longer hypothesis votes neutral and a shorter one votes entailment.
Center the length difference at -24 chars so only unusually long or short hypotheses cast a vote.
Length center halfway at -12 chars, between the entail-heavy e08 (0) and the neutral-heavy e09 (-24).
Adds transport-like actions and more places to the mutually exclusive groups.
Stop-word prefix units clear the VALID flag so coverage is measured on content words only.
Reverts the e12 stop words (no gain) and measures coverage with 4-grams instead of trigrams.
Back to trigram coverage; adds neutral votes for emotions, motives and subjective descriptions a premise rarely confirms.
Each hypothesis concept word whose member (or synonym) appears in the premise votes entailment.
Agreement vote reduced from 1.0 to 0.3 because e15 over-predicted entailment on the dev seed.
Drops the agreement vote (no dev gain); a hypothesis concept whose group is absent from the premise votes neutral.
Flips e17: SNLI contradictions often describe another scene, so a concept new to the premise votes contradiction at 0.5.
New-topic vote disabled; length vote uses hypothesis length alone, centered at 30 chars, ignoring premise length.
Hypothesis-length vote recentered at 38 chars because a 30-char center over-predicted neutral.
Removes the new-topic circuit and restores relative length; a sanity check that should reproduce e14 exactly.
Conflict vote lowered from 4.0 to 2.5 so that one flagged word no longer nearly decides the label.
Conflict vote back at 4.0; length vote raised from 0.08 to 0.12 logits per character.
Length vote back at 0.08; adds entailment votes for hypernyms and generic descriptions.
Drops the e24 hypernyms (no gain); votes entailment when the last hypothesis trigram is found in the premise.
Last-word vote disabled (no gain); entailment coverage threshold moved from 0.65 to 0.55.
Brackets the entailment coverage threshold from above at 0.75, after 0.55 over-predicted entailment.
Simplification: removes the last-word circuit and the number, day/night, instrument and sport conflict groups.
Simplification: removes the color conflict group, since color differences in SNLI are often incidental.
Colors restored (they cost contradiction recall); removes the eat/drink/cook/read/paint/sing activity conflict group.
Mechanism ablation: conflict vote set to zero, measuring what the whole exclusive-group circuit contributes.
Mechanism ablation: length vote set to zero, measuring what relative hypothesis length contributes.
Mechanism ablation: coverage gain set to zero, measuring what trigram overlap with the premise contributes.
Mechanism ablation: every lexicon vote scaled to zero, measuring what the hand word list contributes.
All four mechanisms restored; every lexicon vote scaled by 1.5.
Every lexicon vote scaled by 2.0, following the gain at 1.5.
Lexicon scale back at 1.5, which dev preferred over 2.0; coverage gain raised from 8 to 11.
Coverage gain lowered to 6, after 11 lost accuracy, so other votes can settle borderline cases.
Coverage gain back at 8; simplification removes the weaker contradiction word list.
Weak contradiction words restored; adds a clothing conflict group, by analogy with the useful color group.
Same weights as e40; a measurement-only probe reads CONF directly because e40 matched e35 in every confusion cell.
Clothing group and probe removed (group was wired correctly but changed nothing); length center moved to -15.
Brackets the length center from the other side at -9, after -15 over-predicted neutral.
Length center back at -12; low coverage threshold raised from 0.15 to 0.25.
Brackets the low coverage threshold from below at 0.08, after 0.25 over-predicted contradiction.
Low coverage threshold back at 0.15; simplification removes the vehicle conflict group.
Simplification: drops the two 12-letter words so the window shrinks to 13, removing one attention head.
Simplification: long words become prefixes of at most 8 letters, so the window shrinks to 10 and three more heads go.
Simplification: removes the motive and status word line, whose words are the most common and ambiguous.
Final model: e48 weights restored (the e49 motive words were useful); lexicon, length, coverage and conflict circuits with a 10-char window.
